en.topic_title: Hong Kong gov’t dismisses unemployment concerns among nurses, says non-local hires ‘very small’ in number
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong authorities have defended its policies on hiring non-locally trained nurses, saying that they are “very small” in number following complaints about the import of non-local workers causing unemployment.



The government said in a statement on Tuesday that Hong Kong’s public hospitals have always prioritised the hiring of locally trained professionals.
